अनैकान्त a. (f. न्ता) The same as अनैकान्तिक q.v.

अनैकान्तिक a. (f. का) A kind of fallacy, or हेत्वाभास (in logic). It is of 3 kinds. It is called साधारण if the argument is too general, असाधारण if it is not general enough, and अनुपसंहारिन् if it is non-conclusive.

अनैकान्तिक a. (f. का) A kind of fallacy, or हेत्वाभास (in logic). It is of 3 kinds. It is called साधारण if the argument is too general, असाधारण if it is not general enough, and अनुपसंहारिन् if it is non-conclusive.
अनैक्य n. 1. Plurality; 2. want of union; 3. anarchy.
अनैतिह्य n. Absence of traditional sanction.
